title: finding(core): `convertFiltersToAST` silently drops an empty operator map beside a key that lowers — `{ status: 'a', created: {} }` sends `{ status: 'a' }`, widening the result (spec #5240: REJECTED)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, measured at the adapter's HTTP boundary. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it. It is the sibling of objectui#9164 that the objectui#9164 ruling scoped out, and repairing it needs a ruling, because two merged pins assert the current behaviour.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#9164 dev report (PR objectui#10784, out-of-scope finding, class b).

## Measured (the dev's probe on the PR objectui#10784 head, mocked fetch; ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

`ObjectStackAdapter.find($filter: { status: 'a', created: {} })`:
- plain route: `?filter=["status","=","a"]`;
- `$expand` route: `?populate=owner&filter=["status","=","a"]`.

Both are byte-identical to the control `{ status: 'a' }`. The `created` constraint is dropped silently, so the result is WIDER than the author wrote.

## Contract

`@objectstack/spec` `FilterConditionSchema`'s docblock: "`{ field: {} }` (a field constrained by zero operators): #5240 ruled it REJECTED, and #5327 gated driver-sql / driver-sqlite-wasm / driver-memory / formula".

objectui#9164 (PR objectui#10784) refuses the empty operator map when it is ALL an object says. A `$and` / `$or` member is its own object, so `{ $and: [{ a: {} }, { b: 2 }] }` is now refused too; it used to lower to `['and', ['b', '=', 2]]`. What is left is the same-object spelling: an empty map beside a key that lowers IN THE SAME OBJECT pushes nothing and is not refused.

## Why it needs a ruling

The current behaviour is pinned on purpose:
- objectui#8555 (`filter-date-comparand-8555.test.ts`, "an EMPTY operator object still constrains nothing");
- objectui#8567 (`filter-exotic-comparand-8567.test.ts`).

Refusing here flips those pins. The spec says REJECTED; the pins say "constrains nothing". Under 「协议为基准」 the default reading is to refuse, and the triage decides whether that needs the decision box.

## Direction (for triage)

- Refuse `{ field: {} }` wherever it appears in an operator-map arm, with `FilterOperatorError` naming the field.
- Flip the 8555 and 8567 boundary rows on purpose, with notes, and add dated notes on their pending changesets.
- Census live producers first. The objectui#9164 census found none that emit `{ field: {} }`; re-check the sibling shape.
